models._comment: Local Orpheus text-to-speech via the chatllm.cpp engine (dlopen'd liborpheus_engine.so; needs an ARBITERAI_ENABLE_ORPHEUS build). The model is NOT a plain GGUF: convert with chatllm.cpp's convert.py (OrpheusTTS converter) against the SNAC decoder mlx-community/snac_24khz, then place the resulting .bin under the models dir and point file_path at it.
